answer_correctness.method: Expected-point correctness, 0/1/2 normalized, macro-average. Extra claim errors are separate; not overall accuracy. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answer_completeness.method: Fraction of expected points attempted, regardless of truth; macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

fully_correct_points.method: Fraction of expected points fully correct (2), macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

faithfulness.method: Fraction of inventoried factual claims supported by supplied evidence, macro-average over claim-bearing answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answer_relevance.method: LLM 0 off-topic / 1 partly responsive or extraneous / 2 directly responsive, normalized macro-average. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

citation_support.method: Fraction of assessed claim-citation pairs with semantic support, macro-average over cited answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

citation_coverage.method: Fraction of factual claims with at least one supporting inline citation, macro-average over claim-bearing answers. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

appropriate_abstention.method: Appropriate explicit refusal without invented specifics on unanswerable cases. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

incorrect_abstention.method: Unjustified refusal on answerable cases despite supplied evidence; separate from retrieval-caused refusals. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

answerable_refusal.method: Any full/partial refusal on answerable cases, including missing retrieved evidence. Valid LLM review subset only; see judge reliability.

strict_pass_rate.reason: Run or judgments incomplete; no full-set pass rate.

calibration_agreement.method: Frozen Codex-authored regression labels; pending judgments fail agreement. Not human or held-out accuracy.

correct_answer_rejection.method: Pending is separate from a wrong decision; known-error detection accepts either negative support verdict. Exact verdict classification remains in calibration_agreement.

known_error_miss.method: Pending is separate from a wrong decision; known-error detection accepts either negative support verdict. Exact verdict classification remains in calibration_agreement.

refusal_mismatch.method: Pending is separate from a wrong decision; known-error detection accepts either negative support verdict. Exact verdict classification remains in calibration_agreement.

inventory.method: All completed attempts, including pending/errors; median P50, nearest-rank P95; excludes worker queue wait.

assessment.method: All completed attempts, including pending/errors; median P50, nearest-rank P95; excludes worker queue wait.

judge_call_reliability.method: API success is distinct from judgment validity and label agreement.

judge_throughput.method: Entire calibration batch including logging; no RAG requests.

limitations: Synthetic development regressions with Codex-authored labels; not human annotation or held-out accuracy.
Raw answers, sources and labels are frozen before grading; labels are not sent to the judge.
A single stochastic pass does not establish grader stability. Citation scope remains same-line.
